Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is all we have from this game. The caravan now moves to Dharamsala for the second T20I. That game will start at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT) on Saturday, 26th February. As you know, our coverage will start well in advance. So do join us for the same. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Ishan Kishan is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that he learned a lot from the last three T20Is against West Indies and his intent was not right there. He mentions that pull shot is his favourite shot and he was just waiting to play that shot. He mentions that it is positive thing to play in this big ground as they will get big grounds in Australia. He says that he was just trying to middle the ball during his innings.

Rohit Sharma, the skipper of India, says that there are bound to happen failures in the sport and says that he knows Ishan Kishan’s ability and mindset. He adds that Ishan constructed his innings well and that is more important. He mentions that they want more from Jadeja and he would like him to bat up the order. He says that Jadeja has been batting quite well and they want to utilise his potential. He adds that the ground in Lucknow is quite big and on these kinds of grounds, the batters are tested, so it is good. He mentions that the fielding has been poor and they need to be better in that aspect of the game.

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka, says that they were really poor in all departments and credit should be given to India for the way they played. He adds that they were without Theekshana and Hasaranga and he hopes that Asalanka carries his form into the next game. He says that Chameera is their main bowler and he says that he tries to use him at start as well at death.
Stay tuned for the presentation.

Shreyas Iyer is down for the chat. He says that his start was slow and his job was to give Ishan Kishan strike in the middle. He adds that when he got his eye in, he decided to play his shots and luckily it came off. Tells that he was talking to Ishan about just timing the ball. He says that this ground is big and he tried to stay in the present during his innings. He mentions that he wanted to bowl but did not get the chance tonight.

For India, the bowling was good yet again, Bhuvneshwar Kumar and Bumrah did well in the Powerplay. Chahal too had a decent outing. Venkatesh Iyer went for runs but got two wickets. Rohit tried as many as 7 bowlers and all did decently.

A thumping win for the Indians and they have taken a 1-0 lead in the series. To be honest, this victory was set up by the innings at the start from Kishan and then at the end by Shreyas Iyer. 200 was always going to be tough and when you lose 4 before the 10th with not a lot of runs on the board, it gets tougher. Except for Asalanka amongst the top order and Chameera down the order, there was nothing from the rest and that is not enough while chasing a mammoth score.

So couple of runs to end the game! India have put together another dominating performance! A very full delivery outside off. Dushmantha Chameera lifts this towards deep extra-cover and gets a couple as the fielder at long off cuts it off. India win by 62 runs!
A low full toss on off. Charith Asalanka plays it left of the bowler. Patel half-stops it as a single is taken towards long on.
A yorker this time outside off. Charith Asalanka skips down the track and looks to hit it away but misses.
Another length delivery outside off. Dushmantha Chameera slams it to long on for a single.
A slower length delivery around leg. Charith Asalanka works it towards short fine leg for a single.
A length delivery on off. Dushmantha Chameera heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A yorker on off. Dushmantha Chameera digs it out towards long off for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Chamika Karunaratne works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

A fuller delivery on middle. Charith Asalanka works it to deep mid-wicket for a couple. Fifty for Charith Asalanka. He has been a lone wolf today. Dushmantha Chameera was struggling at the bowler's end as they went for the second run but Bumrah fails to collect the throw cleanly.
Nails a yorker this time outside off. Charith Asalanka looks to dig it out but misses.
A length delivery on off. Dushmantha Chameera pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A low full toss outside off. Charith Asalanka drills it to long off for a single.

FOUR! 21 runs from the over! Almost a yorker this time around off. Dushmantha Chameera gets deep in his crease and steers it towards third man for a boundary. Good over for Lanka but too late now. 75 needed from 12 balls!
FOUR! Another boundary, so Venkatesh Iyer is going for some runs in his third over! A low full toss around leg. Dushmantha Chameera flicks it towards backward square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Full and a bit too wide outside off. Dushmantha Chameera lets it go.
SIX! This time a biggie from Dushmantha Chameera! A slower length ball, on off. Dushmantha Chameera gets low and slog-sweeeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Shorter and outside off. Charith Asalanka cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Charith Asalanka is playing some classy shots, every now and then! A fuller delivery outside off. Charith Asalanka lifts this towards deep extra-cover for a boundary.
Iyer serves this on a length and slower in pace around off. Dushmantha Chameera steers it to short third man for a single.
A single to end as this is worked through mid-wicket.
On middle, defended.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Two more! The sweep is out, it is hit through mid-wicket for two.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
On off, blocked
WIDE! That spins big! Lands outside off and turns back in. It ends up going down the leg side. Wided.
Outside off, on a length. Charith looks to push at it but misses.
Outside off. This is cut over point for one.
Dushmantha Chameera is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! So after playing few good shots, Chamika Karunaratne has to walk back. A length delivery wide outside off. Chamika Karunaratne goes chasing for it but gets an outside edge. The ball goes to the keeper and Ishan Kishan takes an easy catch. So the match is almost gone for Lanka now and it is the matter of if they can play out 20 overs.
Commentary.Howout: c Ishan Kishan b Venkatesh Iyer

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Bang? That goes all the way! Chamika comes down the track and gets to the pitch of it. He whips it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Shorter and on the body, Asalanka pulls, it goes off the glove but lands of short of short fine leg. One taken.
Outside off, Asalanka looks to go over it, he gets an underedge back to the bowler.
Venkatesh Iyer is back on. He went for 7 runs in his first over and took one wicket.
Two more! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
Shorter and on off, this is slapped down to long off for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Lovely shot. Tossed up on off, Asalanka lifts it over covers for a boundary.
On middle, this is worked through mid-widket for one.
SIX! He has hit that beautifully! Lanka need a it to rain boundaries if they are to get close to the Indian total. On middle, fuller, this is lofted over the long on fence for a biggie.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
A single to end! On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
A single to follow the boundary as this is worked towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! That is hit pretty well! This is on middle and the reverse sweep comes out. Samson at deep point runs to his right and dives but it goes well away from him.
Two more then! On the pads, this is worked with soft hands on the leg side for two.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Flattee and on middle, defended.
That one stays low! Outside off, Charith looks to sweep. This one does not bounce a lot and sneaks under the bat.
Flatter and on off, this is one stays a touch low. Asalanka manages to push it to cover.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Two! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket, it is in the gap, two taken.
Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Shorter and outside off, Asalanka looks to cut but gets an underedge on the off side.
A slightly shorter length delivery on off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! A fuller delivery on leg. Charith Asalanka looks to sweep but gets the inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls towards short fine leg. Rohit Sharma there charges in and fires a direct hit at the batter's end. Chamika Karunaratne who is running at the danger end as they try to steal a single. The umpire refers it upstairs and the replays show that he has just made it. So a single in the end.
Is this a run out? The replays roll in and it looks quite tight. Chamika Karunaratne survives as the replays find him just inside the crease.
A quicker delivery on middle. Charith Asalanka blocks it out.
A flatter delivery on middle. Chamika Karunaratne works it towards short fine leg and takes a single.
Shorter and outside off. Charith Asalanka cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Charith Asalanka pushes it to covers.
A fuller delivery on off. Chamika Karunaratne drives it to mid off now.

OUT! CAUGHT! The Sri Lankan skipper departs now!  Sri Lanka have completely lost their way here. A fuller delivery on middle. Dasun Shanaka goes for the reverse-sweep again. This time he connects but hits it straigtht to Bhuvneshwar Kumar at point. He takes an easy catch and half of the side is back to the hut now. Chamika Karunaratne is the next man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Bhuvneshwar Kumar b Yuzvendra Chahal

Commentary.Commentary: A fuller delivery on middle. Dasun Shanaka sweeps it to deep square leg for a couple.
A fuller delivery on off. Pushed towards covers.
A fuller delivery around leg. Dasun Shanaka looks to reverse sweep it but gets hit on the body.
Googly outside off this time. Charith Asalanka pushes it to long off for a single.
Beaten this time! A fuller delivery that is turning away. Dasun Shanaka looks to push at it but misses.
A fuller delivery on middle. Charith Asalanka pushes it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played this time! A flatter delivery on off. Charith Asalanka waits for it and late-cuts it towards the third man region for a boundary.
A slower delivery that is pused hard on length by Jadeja. Shanaka tries to work it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge and the ball goes in the air but just away from Jadeja. A single taken.
Dasun Shanaka is the next man in.

OUT! STUMPED! Another one bites the dust and this time Ravindra Jadeja foxes the batter and Dinesh Chandimal has to walk back. Dinesh Chandimal skips down the track a tad early there and Jadeja pulls his length back and bowls this on middle. Dinesh Chandimal tries to work it towards the leg side but the ball turns away and beats him. Kishan collects the ball,behind the stumps and whips the bails off in the flash as Dinesh Chandimal is out of his crease.
Commentary.Howout: st Ishan Kishan b Ravindra Jadeja

Commentary.Commentary: A shorter delivery on off. Charith Asalanka pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Charith Asalanka cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Dinesh Chandimal knocks it  down to long on for a single.
A flighted delivery on middle. Charith Asalanka defends this off the inside half of his blade to backward square leg for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Pushed towards covers for a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle. Dinesh Chandimal works it towards the leg side.
A shorter delivery outside off. Charith Asalanka cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A fuller delivery around off. Dinesh Chandimal looks to drive it away but misses. 155 needed now from 72 balls!
A flatter delivery on off. Dinesh Chandimal blocks it out.
SIX! This is a good shot and much-needed one for Lanka! A tossed up delivery on middle. Dinesh Chandimal gets low and slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Slightly shorter in length, on middle. Dinesh Chandimal works it to deep backward square leg for a couple.
A flatter delivery on off. Dinesh Chandimal blocks it out.
A flatter delivery around leg. Charith Asalanka works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Dinesh Chandimal is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Venkatesh Iyer gets the wicket now and Sri Lanka sink further! A slower short ball, outside off. Janith Liyanage strangely tries to pull it from way outside off and ends up getting a top edge. The ball loops up in the air towards backward point and Samson there takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Sanju Samson b Venkatesh Iyer

Commentary.Commentary: Short and wide outside off. Janith Liyanage cuts it to deep point for a couple.
Short and wide outside off. Charith Asalanka cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Charith Asalanka punches this off the backfoot to deep cover for a couple.
Shorter length and around off. Janith Liyanage steers it to third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Charith Asalanka dabs it to backward point for a single.
A fuller delivery on leg. Janith Liyanage works it to mid-wicket.
A fuller delivery on off. Charith Asalanka pushes it to backward point for a single.

NOT OUT! Charith Asalanka survives again! This time a good review by him! A tossed up delivery on middle. Charith Asalanka looks to sweep but gets the thin part of his blade onto his pads. There is an huge appeal for LBW and the umpire raises his finger. However, Charith Asalanka reviews it and the replays show a spike off the UltraEdge. So he survives.
A fuller delivery on middle. Janith Liyanage pushes it to long on for a single.

This time Shreyas Iyer drops it! A tossed up delivery on middle. Charith Asalanka slog-sweeps it towards deep square leg but is goes straight to Shreyas Iyer there. He fails to pouch it and this is poor effort by Shreyas Iyer. A single taken.
A fuller delivery down the leg side. Charith Asalanka sweeps it to backward square leg.

Ohh...the ball just lost all its pace as it stops just short of the ropes there! A length delivery on middle. Janith Liyanage lifts this over mid on but the ball strangely does not races away towards the boundary and stops short of the fence. Two runs taken.
A fuller delivery outside off. Janith Liyanage drives it to cover-point this time.
A slower length delivery around leg. Charith Asalanka works it fine towards short fine leg for a single.
On a length, on middle. Charith Asalanka works it to mid-wicket now.
On a length, around off. Janith Liyanage pushes it to covers for a single.
A length delivery around off. Janith Liyanage skips down the track and looks to heave this across the line but misses.
FOUR! Nicely played this one! Shorter and outside off. Charith Asalanka waits for it and just upper cuts it over short third man for a boundary.
This is slower and outside off. Charith Asalanka looks to work it towards the off side but misses.
A length delivery around off. Janith Liyanage steers it to third man for a single.
A length delivery on off. Janith Liyanage blocks this off the front foot.
A yorker on middle this time. Charith Asalanka digs it out behind square on the leg side for a single.
A length delivery around off. Janith Liyanage steers it to third man for a single.
Charith Asalanka is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This time he is gone and Rohit Sharma makes no mistake! A length delivery on off. Kamil Mishara heaves this one hard but straight to Rohit Sharma at mid-wicket. He takes a good catch and second wicket for Bhuvneshwar Kumar now. So Venkatesh Iyer will be a relieved man as that dropped catch has not cost India much.
Commentary.Howout: c Rohit Sharma b Bhuvneshwar Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: A full toss on off. Kamil Mishara drives it to covers now.

Dropped by Venkatesh Iyer!  A length delivery around off. Kamil Mishara looks to hit it across the line but gets a huge top edge. The ball goes in the air towards point and Venkatesh Iyer there settles under it but fails to pouch it. Two runs taken.
A length delivery on off. Kamil Mishara looks to heave it but gets the inside edge onto the pads.
A length delivery around off. Janith Liyanage steers it to third man for a single.
A good-length delivery around off. This one seams away again. Janith Liyanage looks to push at it but gets beaten off the outside edge. Good bounce there too.
Two more! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, Mishara slashes but misses.
A yorker outside off. Mishara fails to jam it out.
Shorter and angling away. Mishara looks to defend but is beaten.
FOUR! Lovely timing! Length and on off, this is driven on the up through covers and for a boundary.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Jasprit Bumrah will share the new ball with Bhuvneshwar Kumar.
Beaten! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Janith is beaten as he tries to defend.
Another one on a length and on off, blocked.
A quick run! On off, this is played on the off side for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Outside off, fuller, this is lofted over point for a boundary.
On off, this is pushed to covers for one.
Janith Liyanage walks in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! That is the worst possible start for Lanka chasing such a big total. Their best player against Australia walks back for a first-baller. Unfortunate for Nissanka though. This is on a length and around off, this lands and then stays low. Nissanka looks to defend, it hits the bottom edge and then rolls behind onto the stump. Kumar has been really good since the last series and has began this well too.
